description.value: Shiraz Villa is a family-owned boutique hotel nestled within a 25-acre vineyard on the outskirts of Osoyoos, offering ten private villas and a two-bedroom guest house with panoramic views of Osoyoos Lake and the surrounding mountains. Each villa features a private patio, Jacuzzi tub, and rain shower, while the guest house includes a fully equipped kitchen with washer and dryer. Located roughly five minutes from Osoyoos town centre, it sits in the heart of the Okanagan wine country along Highway 3, a popular cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is active (copyright 2025, booking functionality present), confirming the business is open. The villas page explicitly lists 'Free Wi-Fi' in both villa types and 'Washer & Dryer' in the Two Bedroom Guest House amenities. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific facilities anywhere on the site, so those remain null. Phone and email on the website match OSM exactly; the address differs in name only (Highway 3 vs Crowsnest Highway, which are the same road) but the website adds city and postal code.
concerns: OSM addr:street is 'Crowsnest Highway'; website uses 'Highway 3' — same road, different name convention. Website also provides city (Osoyoos) and postal code (V0H 1V2) absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active boutique hotel with a functioning website and online booking. A solid accommodation option for cyclists touring the Okanagan along Highway 3.

Laundry.detail: Two Bedroom Guest House amenities list explicitly includes 'Washer & Dryer'

wow_evidence: family-owned boutique hotel nestled within a 25-acre vineyard...panoramic views of Osoyoos Lake
